title: Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles: Towards Scalable Operator Learning with Distribution-Free Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2605.00330v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Operator learning enables fast surrogate modelling of high-dimensional dynamical systems, but existing approaches face two fundamental limitations: the quadratic cost of dense neural layers and unreliable uncertainty quantification in safety-critical settings. We propose Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles, a framework that addresses both challenges simultaneously. Using Quantum Orthogonal Neural Networks (QOrthoNNs), we characterize the resource regime in which their established $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n)$ hidden-layer running-time scaling improves on the $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ cost of a classical dense layer. To quantify uncertainty, we combine ensemble predictions with split conformal calibration. For a new input-output function pair jointly exchangeable with the calibration pairs, we prove a finite-sample, distribution-free lower bound on the expected fraction of covered query locations. translated_title: 共形化量子DeepONet集成：迈向具有无分布保证的可扩展算子学习
translated_abstract: 算子学习能够实现对高维动力系统的快速代理建模，但现有方法面临两个根本性局限：稠密神经层的二次方计算成本，以及安全关键场景中不可靠的不确定性量化。我们提出了共形化量子DeepONet集成，这是一个同时应对这两个挑战的框架。利用量子正交神经网络（QOrthoNNs），我们刻画了其已有的 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n)$ 隐层运行时间标度优于经典稠密层 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 成本的资源区间。为了量化不确定性，我们将集成预测与分割共形校准相结合。对于与校准数据对联合可交换的新输入-输出函数对，我们证明了关于覆盖查询位置期望比例的有限样本、无分布下界。作为次要的概念验证，我们探...
tldr: 本文提出共形化量子DeepONet集成框架，利用量子正交神经网络将隐层计算成本从二次方降至近线性，并结合分割共形校准实现具有有限样本、无分布保证的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles, a framework that leverages quantum orthogonal neural networks to reduce hidden-layer cost from quadratic to near-linear, while combining ensemble predictions with split conformal calibration to achieve finite-sample, distribution-free uncertainty quantification guarantees.
